headlines.title: Is It Worth Investing in American Tower (AMT) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
headlines.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for American Tower (AMT) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

headlines.title: Why Is American Tower (AMT) Adding A New Board Voice On Talent And Governance?
headlines.summary: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) appointed Kristen M. Ludgate to its Board of Directors and its Compensation and Human Capital Committee. Ludgate previously served as Chief People Officer at HP Inc. and held senior leadership roles at 3M. She also brings board experience from companies in the banking and technology sectors. The addition of Kristen M. Ludgate to American Tower's board only partially reflects how the business is evolving.

headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) Stock Could Be 41% Undervalued On Cash Flow
headlines.summary: American Tower has seen its share price under pressure over the past few years, and that slide now puts a spotlight on whether the current US$174.60 level is still supported by the cash it generates. For a business built on long term tower leases and recurring payments, the core issue is how well those cash flows stack up against what the stock market is asking you to pay today. Over the past 5 years the stock has fallen 25.

headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) Upgraded to Buy: What Does It Mean for the Stock?
headlines.summary: American Tower (AMT) might move higher on growing optimism about its earnings prospects, which is reflected by its upgrade to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

description: American Tower Corporation one of the largest global REITs, is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate with a portfolio of over 148,000 communications sites and a highly interconnected footprint of U.S. data center facilities. American Tower Corporation was incorporated in 1995 in Delaware and is based in Massachusetts, Boston.
